text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

Our pilot covered twelve reps across three regions.

1. Reps got back about five hours a week. CRM updates stopped being everyone's Friday-night homework.

2. Accuracy wasn't the issue. Trust was. Adoption jumped once reps could edit summaries before they synced.

3. Managers found the real value in patterns: which objections kept surfacing, which questions won deals.

4. In-person meetings were harder. Noisy cafés and parking-lot calls needed a better capture workflow.

5. Customers asked about recording. Upfront consent made it a non-issue.

The takeaway: AI doesn't replace selling. It removes the admin that was crowding it out.

What would you want your team's notes to actually do?
